summary: Single-storey Pompeian domus, 36x48, mirror-symmetric about x=17.5 on a podium (floor y1, rooms y2..5). Street front has a recessed fauces between four shuttered shops. Behind it come the atrium with a compluvium and impluvium, the tablinum on the same axis, and a 18-column white peristyle around a fountain garden. Sixteen red-tile roof pieces slope inward to the courts (ridges ≤ y9), and the work splits into six parts: shell, roofs, street, atrium, peristyle, finish.

rooms.name: Fauces (entrance passage)
rooms.purpose: Recessed, dim and solemn entrance corridor between the shops. Double spruce doors stand at z=4 with a fanlight above; a lampstand and a potted fern sit at each side (x16, x19 at z=3); the floor has a black centre strip. The whole axis to the garden is visible down it.
rooms.ways_in: Street opening (16..19,2..5,z2) up the step (16..19,1,1); exits into the atrium through (16..19,2..5,z9); side doorways (15,2..3,6) to the west inner shop and (20,2..3,6) to the east inner shop.

rooms.name: Taberna W1
rooms.purpose: Corner shop on the street: a masonry counter in the window, amphorae (decorated pots), barrels and shelves; a working cloth or oil merchant.
rooms.ways_in: Doorway (8,2..3,6) from Taberna W2; street window x3..5 (counter, not a door).

rooms.name: Taberna W2
rooms.purpose: Inner shop or tavern next to the fauces: bar along the street window, barrels, stools, a hanging lamp.
rooms.ways_in: Doorway (15,2..3,6) from the fauces and (8,2..3,6) to W1; street window x10..13.

rooms.name: Taberna E3
rooms.purpose: Mirror of W2: a bakery or wine shop with counter, jars and barrels.
rooms.ways_in: Doorway (20,2..3,6) from the fauces and (27,2..3,6) to E4; street window x22..25.

rooms.name: Taberna E4
rooms.purpose: Mirror of W1: a corner shop with counter, amphorae and shelves.
rooms.ways_in: Doorway (27,2..3,6) from E3; street window x30..32.

rooms.name: Atrium
rooms.purpose: The grand, bright reception hall, open to the sky. The impluvium pool x15..20,z14..17 and its coping are built by the atrium part; keep them clear. Four dark-oak Tuscan columns stand at the compluvium corners. Statues in niches at (11,12) and (24,12), a marble table or bench, pots at the corners, hanging bronze lamps in the roofed ring. Black-and-white checker mosaic with a red border.

rooms.name: Cubiculum C1 (NW)
rooms.purpose: Small, quiet bedroom off the atrium: a bed (red or white), a chest, a small lamp, a pot.

rooms.name: Cubiculum C2 (SW)
rooms.purpose: Bedroom or dressing room: a bed, a chest and a bookshelf, a lamp.

rooms.name: Cubiculum C3 (NE)
rooms.purpose: Mirror of C1: a small bedroom with a bed, a chest and a lamp.

rooms.name: Cubiculum C4 (SE)
rooms.purpose: Mirror of C2: a bedroom with a bed, a chest and a lamp.

rooms.name: Tablinum
rooms.purpose: The master's study on the main axis, open at both ends (to the atrium and to the garden). It holds a desk of lectern and bookshelves, scroll shelves, a chair and a brazier or lamp. Mosaic panel: white field, red and black borders, blue emblem at x17..18,z26..27. Keep the axis x15..20 clear to walk through.
rooms.ways_in: Atrium opening (15..20,2..5,22); peristyle opening (15..20,2..5,31); doorways (10,2..3,27) to the kitchen and (25,2..3,27) to the triclinium.

rooms.name: Culina (kitchen)
rooms.purpose: Working kitchen, warm and smoky. Hearth at the west wall: pad (1..3,y2,25..27), lit campfire at (2,3,26), stone-brick-stair hood at y5 around (2,5,26) under the open flue. Counter with smoker, furnace and crafting table; water cauldron, barrels, a table.

rooms.name: Triclinium
rooms.purpose: Festive dining room. Three couches (red beds with dark-oak rails) on the west, north and east sides and a low table in the middle, open to the south doorway. Niche lamps; meander mosaic with an orange emblem at x29..31,z25..27.
rooms.ways_in: Doorway (25,2..3,27) from the tablinum; opening (27..28,2..4,31) to the colonnade; window (35,3..4,26).

rooms.name: Cubiculum C5 (SW of court)
rooms.purpose: Small bedroom off the peristyle: bed, chest, lamp.

rooms.name: Lararium (C6)
rooms.purpose: Quiet household shrine: an altar niche on the west wall (quartz and stone-brick stairs), candles, a bronze lantern, potted plants, an item frame.

rooms.name: Cubiculum C7 (SE of court)
rooms.purpose: Mirror of C5: a small bedroom with bed, chest and lamp.

rooms.name: Storeroom C8 (apotheca)
rooms.purpose: Store: amphorae (decorated pots), barrels, chests, sacks; plain stone-brick floor.

rooms.name: Peristyle colonnade (covered walkway)
rooms.purpose: Calm, shaded cloister around the open garden. Benches, potted plants and hanging bronze lamps between the white columns, statues at the corners (8,33) and (27,33). The garden court x11..24,z35..41 in the middle is open sky and belongs to the peristyle part; keep it unbuilt.

concept_subject: A Roman town house (domus) seen from its street, 36 blocks wide and 48 deep, single storey, symmetrical about its centre line. The street front is a long cream plaster wall on a stone-brick plinth, with a red-painted dado (the lower two courses) and a cut-sandstone cornice. Under a low red-tile gable roof (brick-red and granite tiles, a mud-brick eave, a pale ridge), the wall is pierced by four open shop windows with masonry counters, clay jars and spruce shutters folded flat on both sides, two on each side of the middle. In the centre a four-wide recessed entrance passage (the fauces) is flanked by two white marble pilasters, with a three-step white pediment above. Two double spruce doors stand set back inside, with a fanlight over them, reached by a stone step from the sidewalk, and bronze lampstands and potted ferns stand beside it. Behind the front block the roof falls inward to the atrium, a bright hall with a black-and-white checker mosaic, open to the sky through an 8x6 square opening. Four dark-oak Tuscan columns stand at its corners, and under it is a shallow rain pool (the impluvium) with a white marble coping; the four small red-tile roof strips slope toward the opening. Straight on the axis, the tablinum (study) opens through white pilasters to a peristyle: a covered colonnade of 18 white marble columns with chiselled capitals, a continuous white architrave and red-tile sheds sloping inward. In the open garden court are two symmetrical parterre beds with clipped hedges of azalea and red and blue flowers, a white marble fountain basin with a central pedestal and water bowls, white statues on stone plinths, rose bushes and potted plants, and bronze lanterns hanging between the columns. Small barred windows, a triclinium with three red couches, cubicula, a kitchen with a hearth and a tall brick chimney stack on the west side, and a rear service door close the block.
concept_size: 36 wide (x), 48 deep (z), single storey (walls to y6, ridges to y9)

parts.name: Villa shell (podium, walls, floors, ceilings, all openings)
parts.scope: Foundation y0 across x0..35, z2..45, and the mosaic floors at y1 per the ROOMS table. Every wall line y1..6 (outer walls z=2, z=45, x=0, x=35; inner walls z=9, 15, 22, 31, x=8, 9, 10, 15, 20, 25, 26, 27, 6, 29) using wallCell roles (stone_bricks plinth, red_terracotta dado y2..3, plaster hash y4..5, cut_sandstone cornice y6). Leave every opening in the OPENINGS table unset, including the plane z=4 in the fauces. Fauces pilasters at (15,z2) and (20,z2). A spruce_planks ceiling at y6 over all rooms and walkways, with the holes at compluvium x14..21,z13..18, garden x11..24,z35..41 and flue (2,6,26). Leave unset: the garden floor and the pool cells x15..20,z14..17 at y1 (P4 and P5 fill them). Use wallLine, wallCell, pilaster, mosaic.

parts.name: Tile roofs sloping inward
parts.scope: All 16 roof pieces R1..R16 from the plan table, at y7..9 (first roof course on the y6 cornice). Use `mcd roof` or roof() with the temple preset as a base (red-tile palette) and the per-piece style, ridge and low-side overrides: gables on R1..R3 and R8..R10, R15, R16; sheds on R4..R7 (atrium pinwheel) and R11..R14 (peristyle pinwheel), low edge toward the court. Dry-run first, no bypass flags except the documented `--why` for overhang 0; overhang only on R1 north (1). Keep the compluvium hole x14..21,z13..18 and the garden hole x11..24,z35..41 open. Then the fauces pediment (x14..21, y7..9, z=2..3, quartz stairs and smooth_quartz) and the kitchen chimney stack (hollow 3x3 stone_bricks x1..3,z25..27,y6..9, core (2,6..9,26) air).
